question:
**Change the following from active to passive**:

They don't allow smoking here.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They don't allow smoking here."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "smoking" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "don't allow" to "isn't allowed" (present simple passive).
 
• Ensure the phrase "here" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Smoking isn't allowed here."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Smoking hasn't been allowed here." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Smoking wasn't allowed here." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"Smoking shouldn't be allowed here." – Incorrect modality (suggestion rather than fact).
